justification: HOLY COW folks, we're runnin' it right back with the fellas who got us here -- Jordy Love slingin' it for the Pack, Bijan and Swift carryin' the rock like a couple of freight trains, Hock and Likely givin' us a double dose at tight end, and Diggs out there makin' it look easy! Zay's locked in up top from Thursday night and I wouldn't move him for anybody anyway, that's a hot bat waitin' to turn it back on any day now! Now listen, I know ol' Boswell's got no game on the board this week with Pittsburgh on a bye -- same deal with my man Rodgers, he's restin' that golden arm -- but there ain't another kicker on this bench to turn to, so Boswell trots out there and we tip our cap to the schedule, folks, that's just baseball -- er, football! Ravens D rounds us out, already banked from Thursday. A little rain never hurt anybody, and neither does a bye week -- we play the cards we're dealt and we play 'em with a smile!
forum_post: HOLY COW Lisa, I see ya down to zero dollars pickin' up Loves off the scrap heap while the OTHER one's hurt -- that's a heckuva soap opera and I love every minute of it!
